landing.html.greet: Welcome! I can help you quickly sign up, login, or understand what this portal offers.

index.html.greet: Need help finding a mess? Ask about search, location filters, or how to place an order.

mess.html.greet: I can guide you through selecting items, using wallet balance, and placing your order.

login.html.greet: Owner login support is here. I can help with account access and role confusion.

create-account.html.greet: I can help you create a student account with OTP using phone or email.

order-history.html.greet: I can help you read order history, payment status, and jump to tracking.

track-order.html.greet: Ask me about order status steps, refresh, or cancellation rules.

intentRules.response: You can see the info about our website, explore mess options, place orders, track live status, and manage account/payment flow from here.
Use the search area on the home page. You can filter by name and location, then click Search to get matching messes.
Let me open your Track Order page to find your order status.
To place an order: open a mess, add items, review cart, fill your details, and click Book Food. If asked, complete payment and upload proof.
Use the Track Order page and search with your order ID. You can refresh status anytime, and some orders can be cancelled before preparation completes.
Open My Orders to view your previous orders, their statuses, and payment details.
Payment flow: scan QR, pay exact amount, upload a clear screenshot, then share confirmation if prompted. Keep order ID and payment proof visible.
For OTP issues, check phone/email format, wait 30-60 seconds, then use Resend OTP. Verify network and spam folder for email mode.
Choose phone mode if you want the OTP sent to your mobile number, or email mode if you want it sent to your email address. Use the option where you can access the OTP fastest.
If you already have a saved account, continue by signing in instead of creating a new one. Open the Login page to access your existing account.
Owner dashboard lets you add menu items, review incoming orders, and move status from pending to completed.
Admin dashboard can add and edit mess records with location, veg type, and contact details.
Owners use Login page credentials. Students can create a visitor account with OTP from Create Account page.
Open Create Account, choose phone or email mode, request OTP, verify code, and your student account is ready.
For payment receipt sharing, use the numbers visible on payment confirmation screen. For account or order issues, use the page tools first, then contact the mess owner.

If you have wallet balance available, it will be shown during checkout. You can use it to pay part or full amount for your order. The balance will be deducted automatically after you complete the order.
